reading.title: Bioluminescence in Deep Sea Creatures
reading.passage: Bioluminescence is the production of light by living organisms through chemical reactions. In the deep ocean, where sunlight cannot reach, many creatures use bioluminescence for communication, hunting, and defense. The anglerfish, for example, uses a glowing lure to attract prey in complete darkness. Scientists estimate that approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures produce their own light. This adaptation allows organisms to survive in one of Earth's most extreme environments, demonstrating the remarkable diversity of life.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is the primary purpose of bioluminescence in deep-sea creatures?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'bioluminescence for communication, hunting, and defense'라고 명시되어 있습니다. 이것이 심해 생물들의 생물발광의 주요 목적입니다.

questions.q: Which of the following is mentioned as an example of a bioluminescent creature?
questions.explanation: 본문에서 'The anglerfish, for example, uses a glowing lure to attract prey'라고 구체적으로 제시되었습니다.

questions.q: What does the passage suggest about the prevalence of bioluminescence in deep-sea creatures?
options: It is found in most deep-sea creatures
questions.explanation: 'Scientists estimate that approximately 90% of deep-sea creatures produce their own light'는 생물발광이 심해 생물들 중 매우 흔하다는 것을 의미합니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Technology has made education more accessible to people around the world'?

structure.intro: 주장을 명확히 제시하세요. 예: 'I strongly agree that technology has significantly improved access to education globally.'
structure.body1: 첫 번째 근거: 온라인 학습 플랫폼(Coursera, Khan Academy)이 저비용으로 양질의 교육을 제공하는 방식
structure.body2: 두 번째 근거: 개발도상국 학생들이 인터넷을 통해 세계 최고의 교육에 접근할 수 있게 됨
structure.conclusion: 재정리와 함께 기술의 긍정적 영향을 요약하고, 향후 발전 가능성 제시

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer to study alone in a quiet environment. Others prefer to study in groups with classmates. Which do you prefer and why?
sample_points: 조용한 환경에서의 집중력: 방해 없이 깊은 이해 가능, 자신의 속도로 학습 가능
그룹 스터디의 장점: 다양한 관점 학습, 어려운 부분을 함께 해결, 동기부여 증진

listening.title: Campus Library Services Discussion
listening.script: Librarian: Good afternoon! How can I help you today? Student: Hi, I'm new to campus and I'm not sure how to use the library resources. Librarian: Welcome! Let me show you our online database system. We have access to thousands of academic journals and e-books. You can search from anywhere, even your dorm room. Student: That's great! What about borrowing physical books? Librarian: You can borrow up to 20 books at a time, and they're due back in three weeks. We also offer research consultation services where librarians can help you find sources for your papers. Student: Do you offer workshops on research skills? Librarian: Absolutely! We hold workshops every Thursday at 3 PM. This month we're covering how to evaluate source credibility and cite properly. I highly recommend attending. Student: Perfect! I'll definitely come. Thank you so much!

questions.q: What is the main topic of this conversation?
options: How to check out books from the library
An overview of campus library services and resources
The history of the university library
questions.explanation: 대화에서 사서가 온라인 데이터베이스, 책 대출, 연구 상담, 워크숍 등 도서관의 다양한 서비스를 설명하고 있습니다.

questions.q: According to the librarian, how many books can a student borrow at one time?
questions.explanation: 사서는 'You can borrow up to 20 books at a time'이라고 명확히 말했습니다.

questions.q: When are the research skills workshops held?
questions.explanation: 사서가 'We hold workshops every Thursday at 3 PM'이라고 구체적으로 언급했습니다.
